2608.04574.title: When Memory Lies: An Empirical Study of Spatial Memory Staleness in VLM Agents
2608.04574.paper_summary: Memory-augmented VLM agents act on persistent spatial knowledge, yet that knowledge silently goes stale as the environment changes. We ask what happens when an agent must reconcile a confident memory claim with a contradicting observation, and whether current models can catch the conflict before it becomes a safety-relevant mistake. Using a dynamic FrozenLake testbed, we pair a staleness-detection task with a downstream navigation task across three closed-source models and three open-weight VLMs under both text and image inputs (1,800 detection runs, and 12,000 text-mode navigation episodes over four LLM navigators at a shared 50-seed scale). Three findings emerge. First, text solvability does not imply visual grounding: models that flag stale entries reliably from text nonetheless span vision F1 from 0.887 down to 0.067 on the identical grids, and the weakest keeps making fluent, confident decisions that ignore the image. Second, consuming stale memory without an audit is a safety liability: in our primary GPT-4o setting, an agent that trusts raw memory dies more than twice as often as the same agent given no memory at all. Third, auditing helps but does not close the gap: a transparent read-time filter removes much of the safety cost in text mode, yet even oracle stale labels bring no further significant gain on the current grid size, and when visual auditing is unreliable, filtering yields no consistent benefit. Together these results frame spatial-memory staleness as a safety failure mode and isolate reliable visual grounding and action selection under memory--observation conflict as the central open challenges for memory-augmented agents.
2608.04574.paper_summary_zh: 記憶增強的 VLM 代理基於持久的空間知識行動，但隨著環境的變化，這些知識會靜默地過時。我們探討當代理必須調和一個自信的記憶主張與一個矛盾的觀察時會發生什麼，以及當前模型是否能在衝突成為安全相關錯誤之前捕捉到這一衝突。使用動態的 FrozenLake 測試平台，我們將過時檢測任務與三個封閉源模型和三個開放權重 VLM 在文本和圖像輸入下的下游導航任務配對（1,800 次檢測運行，以及在共享 50 隨機種子規模下的 12,000 次文本模式導航回合）。三個發現浮現出來。首先，文本的可解性並不意味著視覺的基礎：從文本中可靠標記過時條目的模型在相同的網格上，視覺 F1 從 0.887 降至 0.067，而最弱的模型仍然做出流暢、自信的決策，卻忽略了圖像。第二，消耗過時記憶而不進行審計是一種安全隱患：在我們的主要 GPT-4o 設定中，信任原始記憶的代理死亡的頻率是同一代理沒有任何記憶的兩倍以上。第三，審計有幫助但無法彌補差距：透明的即時過濾器在文本模式下消除了大部分安全成本，但即使是神諭過時標籤在當前網格大小上也未帶來進一步的顯著增益，並且當視覺審計不可靠時，過濾也未能帶來一致的好處。這些結果共同將空間記憶的過時框架視為一種安全失效模式，並將在記憶與觀察衝突下的可靠視覺基礎和行動選擇孤立為記憶增強代理的主要開放挑戰。
2608.04574.author: Yushi Sun et.al.
